cards.title: Show the numbers
cards.text: Show numbers on modules and upgrades ('Bounce 2 → 3')?
cards.why: Your maze doc said hidden numbers, visible results. Your brief here says '+1 bounces on a bounce module'. Survivor games live on reading the upgrade, so I went with shown.
cards.pick: Shown here. The maze roguelike keeps its hidden rule.

cards.title: Rarity caps
cards.text: Rarity limits how far a module levels. Which caps?
cards.why: Low caps make finding a rare copy exciting; high caps make XP matter more than chests.

options.label: 5 / 5 / 5 / 5 + perks
options.text: Same cap; rarity adds a bonus effect instead.

cards.title: Duplicates promote
cards.text: A higher-rarity copy of a module you own promotes yours and keeps its levels?
cards.why: Without it, finding a better Bounce means throwing away the levels on the old one, which feels bad.
cards.pick: Yes, promote and keep levels; a lower copy gives +1 level.

cards.title: Move modules freely
cards.text: On the build screen, move any module between Weapon, Summon and Dash at any time?
cards.why: Building is the point, so trying Explode on the Dash instead of the Ball should cost nothing. The cost is that slots per cast matter less.
cards.pick: Yes, free, any time you pause.

cards.title: Shape cards in chests
cards.text: Rare chests can hold a shape card that swaps a cast's shape mid-run?
cards.why: Turning your Bolt build into a Beam build halfway through a run is the clearest proof that modules are generic. It's also how Runes get filled.

cards.title: Runes in the first version
cards.text: Include Runes (open sockets) from the start, at Epic and up?
cards.why: They're how big spells get built, which you said is the main goal. They're also the most complex screen to make on a phone.
cards.pick: Yes, in stage 5, Epic and up. The fixed spawners come first.

cards.title: How deep spells nest
cards.text: Things that make things: 2 deep in a run, 3 with an unlock?
cards.why: Deeper means bigger spells and a busier screen. 3 is enough for Wings' death aura.
cards.pick: 2, and 3 with an unlock. No limit in the practice room.
